annotations.title: Show per-GB traffic: GB left, packs, countries

description: Read-only, free. Show the account's per-GB traffic: the traffic key's state, GB bought, used and left, the gateway host and ports, the countries the residential and the shared mobile pool have now, and the prepaid packs with their prices. It shows no secret; get_traffic_connection gives a connection line. Needs an API key or an agent token of an ipvolt account.
name: list_traffic
